description: de la Red de Vigilancia Volcánica del IGN is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by wms-volcanologia.ign.es. Information about the National Geographic Institute's volcanic surveillance network. WMS 1.3.0 display service according to ISO 19128:2005 Inspire profile. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "WMS of the Volcanic Surveillance Network of the IGN" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Instituto Geográfico Nacional, Sismología, Geomagnetismo, Erupción, IGN, Geofísica. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
